• Clears Play Store + Google Play services + Services Framework data.

Siguradu ka?

strings.mdKbSmart: • Smart keybox fetch: tignan ne ing kasalukuyan a keybox laban keng Google's revocation list (CRL) ampo subukan nala deng dakal a sources anggang akit ne ing valid keybox, a maki automatic backup ampo pamag-restart kareng Google a serbisyu. Magdalagan ya balang tap at mangailangan yang internet (1-3 minutu).
strings.mdKbNet: • Keybox ibat keng network: magdownload yang keybox ibat keng opisyal a repository (GitHub) at i-save ne keng /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. Kailangan ing internet at mangailangan yang 1-3 minutu. Gagamitan ya nung ing smart fetch mebigu ya o nung ing keybox mibayu yang manual.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP diagnosis: tignan ne ing available a Remote Key Provisioning modules, tignan ne ing TEE attestation certificate version, at papakit ne ing KmInstallKeybox tool state. Ala yang pamagbayu — metung a plain a device status view.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine check (read-only): papakit na ing Widevine level indicators (L1/L3) ibat keng dumpsys, DRM (IDM) key-file presence, ampo reng kaugnayan a system properties. Ala yang pamagbayu nanu man.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Manual RKP ayusan: magdalang sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh manual. Ayus nala deng isyung attestation nung ing automatic pass mebigu ya. Balang dalagan magprint yang malino linya ning tagumpe/kabiguan.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Full RKP fix: magdalang sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh full. Asikasu no reng masakit a kasu at mas makaba ya. Ing malino resulta lumwal ya keng wakas.
strings.mdGmsReset: • I-reset ing GMS: linawe ne ing Play Store ampo Google a serbisyu (GMS+GSF) data ampo i-reboot ne ing device automatic. Para keng matigas a attestation mu — e ya makatagkil kareng kekang litrato o file.
strings.mdCertify: • Play certification: tignan ne ing RKP certificate attestation state ning device at i-reset ne ing attestation properties nung kailangan. E ya tatagkil keng data ning gagamit.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER repair: ayusan na ing Google services framework (SOTER) issues a maki kaugnayan keng device attestation. Gagamitan ya para kareng mapilan a devices na magdependi keng SOTER imbes na keng Play Integrity.
strings.mdPifApply: • I-apply ing PIF: magdalang sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh force. I-apply ne ing mepiling fingerprint (local/advanced) at i-update ne ing pif.prop/pif.json files. Ing malino resulta linwal ya keng log.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF check: papakit na ing maka-install a estado ning makina, deng fingerprint files (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), ampo reng logs. Check mu — ala yang pamagbayu.
strings.mdCanary: • Canary update: magdalang sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Kinua ne ing bayung Canary Engine release para makasiguradung compatible ya kareng mandatory RKP certificates (February 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Engine diagnosis: tignan ne ing TrickyStoreOSS state (pid, logs), ing keybox files (active vs user), ing real vs spoofed device fingerprint, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP keys. Diagnostic display mu.
strings.hintKbSlots: Ing module mamahala ya kareng adwang keybox slot: ing mumunang (sacred, e ya mepunas) ampo ing secondary (backup). Iting tab papakit na nung sanung slot ing active, magbayu ya ing preference, o magpromote ya keng secondary papunta keng primary keng explicit a request — a maki backup ampo ing ganap a log.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Integrity diagnosis: tignan ne ing TEE key import, ing library injection kilub ning keystore2, ing revocation status (CRL), ing protection-list coverage ampo ing RKP state. Read-only — ala yang alilan.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
🔧 Ligtas yang pamag-apply pasibayu:

• Ing listahan ning proteksyun me-rebuilt ya ibat kareng balang maka-install a app.
• Ing custom-ROM compatibility layer mi-re-apply ya.
• Ing aktibung keybox mi-re-apply ya.
#000#000 #serbisyu la me-restart.

Alang mebura at ing primary keybox e ya me-touch.

Continue?
strings.mdKbSlots: • Keybox slots: papakit na ing estado da reng primary ampo secondary slots ampo lilipat ne ing buri da. Ing mumunang (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) parati yang protektadu at e ya mapupunas. Ing pamag-promote keng secondary keng primary mangailangan yang malino a kumpirmasyun.
strings.confirmKbSlotsPromote:
⬆️ Promote the secondary slot to primary:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml becomes the primary slot content.
• The current primary is saved as a backup before replacement.
• Nothing is deleted — the operation is reversible.

Continue?
strings.confirmKbSlotsClear:
🧹 Linisan me ing secondary slot:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml milako ya.
• E ya me-touch ing primary slot.

Ituloy?

strings.confirmKbSmart:
Smart keybox fetch (bayu keng v3.17):

• Check ne ing kasalukuyan a keybox laban keng Google revocation list (CRL).
• susubukan nala deng dakal a sources anggang mayakit yang malinis a keybox.
• Automatic backup + restarts #000## services.

⚠️ Needs internet (1-3 min). Sundu?
strings.confirmKbNet:
Kuanan me ing keybox ibat keng internet:

• I-download ne ing opisyal a keybox at i-validate ne.
• Me-install yang permanenti (e never mibalik keng boot).

⚠️ Kailangan ing internet (anggang 1 min). Sundu?
strings.confirmRkpManual:
Re-provision RKP keys:

• Ala nang data o keybox files a mebura.
• I-reboot me ing teleponu kaybat.

Ituloy?
strings.confirmRkpFull:
Full repair:

• Re-provisions RKP + restarts Google services.
• Ing device mag-reboot yang automatic (ala nang me-wipe).

Ituloy?
strings.confirmGmsReset:
Restart Google services:

• GMS + Play Store + GSF — restart only.
• Nothing is wiped and you will NOT be signed out.
• The device reboots automatically.

Continue?
strings.confirmRkpForce:
Force re-provision (Red Magic):

• Para kareng devices na e pansinan ing leaked keybox.
• Gagana ya agyang masalese la reng keys.
• Ala yang data ing mebura.

Continue?
strings.confirmCertify: Pilitan me ing Store cache — e ya me-touch ing kekang account.
strings.confirmSoter:
SOTER repair:

• I-restart ne ing vendor.soter serbisyu.
• I-clear ne ing SOTER server data mu.

Ituloy?
strings.confirmPifApply:
I-apply ing fingerprint (PIF):

• I-convert ne ing custom.pif.prop at i-install ne keng engine path.
• Kailangan ing reboot kaybat.

Ituloy?
strings.confirmCanary:
I-update ing Canary fingerprint:

• I-download ne ing bayung opisyal a Canary fingerprint ibat keng Google.
• I-sync ne ing security patch + i-restart ne ing Google services (alang wipe).

⚠️ Kailangan ing internet (1-3 min). Sundu?
